tasks.label: Start iOS Simulator
tasks.command: if xcrun simctl list devices booted | grep -q 'iPhone'; then exit 0; fi; UDID=$(xcrun simctl list devices available | awk -F '[()]' '/iPhone/{print $2; exit}'); if [ -z "$UDID" ]; then echo "No available iOS simulator found. Install one from Xcode > Settings > Platforms."; exit 1; fi; open -a Simulator; xcrun simctl boot "$UDID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; xcrun simctl bootstatus "$UDID" -b >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

tasks.label: Start Android Emulator
tasks.command: SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; EMU="$SDK/emulator/emulator"; DEVICE_ID="emulator-5554"; wait_for_boot() { "$ADB" -s "$DEVICE_ID" wait-for-device; until [ "$("$ADB" -s "$DEVICE_ID" shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do sleep 1; done; }; if [ ! -x "$ADB" ] || [ ! -x "$EMU" ]; then echo "Android SDK not found at $SDK. Install it from Android Studio."; exit 1; fi; if "$ADB" devices | grep -q "^${DEVICE_ID}[[:space:]]"; then wait_for_boot; exit 0; fi; AVD=$("$EMU" -list-avds | awk 'NF { print; exit }'); if [ -z "$AVD" ]; then echo "No Android Virtual Device found. Create one in Android Studio > Device Manager."; exit 1; fi; nohup "$EMU" -avd "$AVD" >/dev/null 2>&1 & wait_for_boot
